title: Inspire Black Nitrile Gloves HEAVY DUTY 6 Mil Nitrile Chemical Resistant Medical Cooking Cleaning Disposable Black Gloves

reviews.title: Durable Gloves – Thick, Strong, and Great for Cooking & Cleaning (Runs Slightly Small)
reviews.body: I purchased these gloves for everyday cooking and household cleaning, and overall I’m very satisfied with the quality.The material feels thick and durable, not flimsy like some disposable or low-quality gloves. They fit well on the hands and provide a secure, comfortable feel during use. I ordered a medium size, and they are slightly on the snug side, but not in a way that affects functionality. In fact, the closer fit actually improves grip and control when handling kitchen tasks or cleaning.What impressed me most is the toughness of the material. They feel resistant to tearing and hold up well even during longer use, which makes them suitable for extended cleaning sessions or food prep.The only thing I would note is sizing. They seem to run a little small, so it’s important to choose the correct size carefully. That said, for me the slightly smaller fit was not an issue and actually made them feel more secure.Overall, these gloves are well-made, durable, and practical for both cooking and cleaning. I would definitely purchase them again.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 6, 2026
reviews.author: Anna Spiridonova

reviews.title: Comfort & strength of the gloves. Might consider upsizing on the gloves from your normal wear.
reviews.body: I just received them today. Tried them own, due to I had upsized the gloves from large to xtra large and the fit was perfect. The 6mil thickness of the gloves is a definite plus due to the strength. Very comfortable and fit. This first attempt was pulling the meat off a roasted chicken. Pure pleasure to the task. Looking forward to other tasks.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 12, 2026
reviews.author: Walter F Recker Sr

reviews.title: Great Gloves for the Kitchen!
reviews.body: We really like these nitrile gloves a lot! We use these at home when we handle raw meat or really anything that we don't want to get on our hands. These are nice and thick gloves - but not too thick to where you can't move or feels things and not too thin to where they rid. You still have full dexterity and grip on things. I also feel safe when using these gloves when cutting things. They are thicker, so they won't cut super easy. I haven't tried washing them - though I have used the gloves to cover a cut that had a bandaid on it while I washed dishes, and my hands stayed dry throughout the dish cleaning process. We will be buying these gloves again!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 23, 2026
reviews.author: Greenfields

reviews.title: Best affordable, disposable gloves I've ever known
reviews.body: I work in healthcare and Nitrile is the best glove. You can delicately feel through them, use on a touch screen, keep out loads of caustics from seeping to your hands, and they ave very durable. Also, when stored away for a while they deteriorate very slowly. I bought these after using up a box about 5 years old, and they were just as durable as a new box.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 31, 2026
reviews.author: B Tyred

reviews.title: Great Gloves but Run Small
reviews.body: I had bought XL Hal yard gloves, but tried these after reading good reviews.  The XL was very tight on my not-huge hands.  The gloves are thicker, as noted in other reviews, which is nice as they do not tear.  I have ordered the XXL as the gloves are great except I thought they ran small.

reviews.author: mgk

reviews.title: Good quality and Good Fit
reviews.body: Good quality. Not too thin, not too thick. Just right for working on cars and trucks.Size is right on. I usually wear large gloves. Others said they ran small so I ordered XL. They’re a little loose. Okay for some work, but not tight enough for any real fingertip dexterity. So I ordered L (large) and they fit perfectly.Recommend.

reviews.title: Good gloves
reviews.body: My go to when painting, handling fertilizer or chemicals, or other nasty stuff. Good price and they are very durable. A bit difficult ti slip on when my hands are already wet though. Just make sure your hands are dry before putting them on.
